results.title: India Women vs Japan Quarterfinal: A Dominant Start to India’s Asian Games 2026 Campaign
results.description: India Women began their Asian Games 2026 campaign with a commanding eight-wicket victory over Japan in the women’s cricket quarterfinal at Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin, Aichi, on September 18. The match was particularly significant as India entered the tournament as the defending Asian Games champions and were looking to begin their title defence on a strong note. Led by Harmanpreet Kaur, India won the toss and elected to bowl first. The decision quickly paid off as India’s bowlers restricted Japan to just 57 runs in 19.5 overs.
